gates.max_peak_rss_rationale: STANDARD Günther tier (8–16 GiB). Peak must leave headroom on 15 GiB host; phi4-mini catalog ram_gb_min=5.0.
gates.max_avg_s_per_cv_note: No explicit product CV-import latency SLA found in project docs. Time is measured and reported; absence of a numeric budget is flagged in the report.
gates.clearly_better_rule: Recommend blindtest only if Phi F1 − DET F1 ≥ 0.05 on this sample AND peak RSS ≤ 8192 MB. Smoke/known-corpus win alone is insufficient for productive swap.

disclaimer: Known Mini-30 development sample — not an independent blind test. IH2 frozen F1 0.7246 is context only. PR#59 ~0.73 was section-accuracy, not F1.
not_proven: That section-accuracy equals F1 (it does not)
That IH2 post-analysis F1 1.0 is an independent result (it is not)
